note: Proposal only. Not a batch manifest: it lives outside factory/batches/, carries no jobs, release, recipient or money, and nothing reads it at launch. Founder approval plus a separately reviewed admission change are required before any real manifest is built from it.
creation_accounting: Every VM creation counts once: initial lifecycles, checkpoint resumes, diagnosis resumes, extensions, factory-bug resumes, replacements and infrastructure retries. Reaching 48 stops new admissions; it is never raised silently.

completion_timeout_context.pilot_cutoff_source: docs/designs/pilot-run.md (diagnosis experiment that expects unfinished cases; not a completion timeout)

concurrency_rule: Stay at 1 until parallel admission, spending and cleanup are qualified (docs/cloud-handoff.md checklist).
ramp_rule: Skip milestones already satisfied; audit finished cases while independent builds continue.
replacement_policy: As ENGINEERING section 3: a case out of rounds or budget goes to diagnosis and a replacement launches at once; both count toward the 48 creations.

roles.rule: Reference to the already reviewed pins; this proposal adds and changes no model route.

shortfall_estimate: At the historical public G1-G15 rate (3 of 50 hidden cards, 6%), 48 creations would be expected to yield about 3 cases, far short of 24; even those need G16/G10/G17, a dedup check and registry promotion before they are eligible. Report the shortfall; do not raise limits or lower quality silently.
blockers: Legacy G1-G15 cards (fcde6b, 86b100, 18681d): G16/G10/G17 rerun, dedup check and registry promotion (historical entries are complete:false); the audit rerun produces neither of the last two.
Reviewed admission change: pilot-bounded-roles admission is bound to b-real-pilot with exactly three templates.
